findings.claim: The sealed trajectories record only 5 s class-level statistics: class rate and active fraction per window, E sync per window, and for windows 1-3 ISI fraction and rate CV. No V_PV, u_PV, synaptic current (E->PV, PV->PV, SST->PV), synaptic trace or spike raster is stored; chunk 0 (0-5 s after the switch) is not recorded.

PV rate already differs from the active trajectory beyond max(1 Hz, 10%) in window 1 for both collapsing trajectories (fresh 16.88, lambda-0 history 17.05, active 14.65 Hz). No recorded variable can precede the PV-rate divergence at the recorded resolution.

E and VIP rates never diverge beyond tolerance; SST diverges only in fresh window 3 (19.92 vs 22.34 Hz), coincident with the fresh PV dip to 10.2 Hz. E sync is 0.0 in every window of every trajectory.

PV active fraction stays 1.0 in the active trajectory. It falls gradually in fresh (1.0 through window 5, then 0.85, 0.65, 0.575, 0.525, 0.475, 0.2) and abruptly after lambda-0 history (1.0, 1.0, 0.975, 0.075, 0.0): PV cells drop out progressively, not all at once, in the fresh collapse.

not_inferred: No mechanism is assigned. Class-mean E rate equality does not establish equal E->PV input (it omits which E cells fire and spike timing relative to PV).
